info.name: Purrfect Match Backend API
info.description: Backend-only API collection for local Docker development. Run Docker and migrations first, then import the companion environment. Some setup steps use local API calls; admin/breeder verification still needs local DB bootstrap if no admin seed exists.

item.name: Login admin candidate
item.description: Before running admin requests, promote this generated user in local Docker PostgreSQL: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d purrfect_match -c "UPDATE users SET role='admin' WHERE email='{{adminEmail}}';"

item.name: 02 Breeder And Listings
item.description: If certification upload or admin bootstrap is not available, use Docker psql to create/verify a breeder profile for the generated breeder user before creating a listing.

item.name: 04 Admin Moderation
item.description: Requires adminToken. If the API has no admin bootstrap route, create/mark the generated admin user in local PostgreSQL before running this folder.
